CLASS CL_CI_TEST_SELECT IMPLEMENTATION.


method clear.

  check not CLR_SELECT_STATEMENTS = 'X'.
  SUPER->CLEAR( ).
  clear SELECT_STATEMENTS.
  CLR_SELECT_STATEMENTS = 'X'.

endmethod.


method GET.
  data:
    L_SELECT like line of SELECT_STATEMENTS.

  CLR_SELECT_STATEMENTS = ' '.

  if ( object_Type eq c_Type_Web_Dynpro ).  " Web Dynpro denies database access at all
    return.                                 " see CL_WDY_CI_TEST_CONVENTIONS
  endif.                                    " ABAP Web Dynpro Conventions

  if REF_SCAN is initial.
    check SUPER->GET( ) = 'X'.
  endif.

  check REF_SCAN->SUBRC = 0.
  check SELECT_STATEMENTS is INITIAL.

  loop at REF_SCAN->STATEMENTS into STATEMENT_WA.
    check STATEMENT_WA-FROM <= STATEMENT_WA-TO.
*-- avoid native SQL
    check STATEMENT_WA-TYPE NE 'E'.
*-- avoid unexpanded MAKROS
    check STATEMENT_WA-TYPE NE 'M'.

    L_SELECT = SY-TABIX.
    case KEYWORD( ).
      when 'SELECT'.
        append L_SELECT to SELECT_STATEMENTS.
      when 'OPEN'.
        if GET_TOKEN_REL( 2 ) = 'CURSOR'.
          append L_SELECT to SELECT_STATEMENTS.
        endif.
    endcase.
  endloop.

  P_RESULT = 'X'.

endmethod.                    "get
ENDCLASS.

class CL_CI_TEST_FOR_ALL_ENTRIES definition
  public
  inheriting from CL_CI_TEST_SCAN
  create public

  global friends CL_CM_CHK_FOR_ALL_ENTRIES .

public section.
*"* public components of class CL_CI_TEST_FOR_ALL_ENTRIES
*"* do not include other source files here!!!
  type-pools ABAP .
  type-pools SANA .
  type-pools SCAN .

  methods CONSTRUCTOR .

  methods GET_MESSAGE_TEXT
    redefinition .
  methods RUN
    redefinition .
protected section.
private section.

  constants C_MY_NAME type SEOCLSNAME value 'CL_CI_TEST_FOR_ALL_ENTRIES' ##no_text .
  constants:
    begin of c_Pitfall,
      likely_No_Content_Check          type sci_Errc value 'FAllUnsafe',
      likely_No_Local_Content_Check    type sci_Errc value 'FAllRisky',
    end of c_Pitfall .

  methods REPORT_UNSAFE_QUERY
    importing
      !QUERY_NDX type SYTABIX
      !TABLE_VAR_NAME type STRING
      !has_EXTERNAL_CONTENT type ABAP_BOOL .
ENDCLASS.



CLASS CL_CI_TEST_FOR_ALL_ENTRIES IMPLEMENTATION.


method CONSTRUCTOR .
  super->constructor( ).
  me->description    = 'Unsecure use of FOR ALL ENTRIES'(000).
  me->category       = 'CL_CI_CATEGORY_ROBUSTNESS'.
  me->position       = '999'.
  me->version        = '002'.
  me->has_Attributes = abap_False.
  me->attributes_Ok  = abap_True.

  data:
    sci_Message like line of me->scimessages.

  define declare_Message.
    clear sci_Message.
    sci_Message-test = c_my_name.
    sci_Message-code = &1.
    sci_Message-kind = &2.
    sci_Message-text = &3.
    sci_Message-pcom = &4.
    insert sci_Message into table me->scimessages.
  end-of-definition.

  declare_Message:
    c_Pitfall-likely_No_Local_Content_Check
    c_Note
    'Possible use of &1 without prior content check within procedure'(003)
    c_Exceptn_Imposibl.

  declare_Message:
    c_Pitfall-likely_No_Content_Check
    c_Warning
    'Possible use of &1 without prior content check'(002)
    c_Exceptn_Imposibl.
endmethod.


method GET_MESSAGE_TEXT.
  case p_Code.
    when c_Pitfall-likely_No_Content_Check.
      p_Text =
        'Possible use of &1 without prior content check'(002).

    when c_Pitfall-likely_No_Local_Content_Check.
      p_Text =
        'Possible use of &1 without prior content check within procedure'(003).

    when others.
      super->get_Message_Text(
        exporting p_Test = p_Test p_Code = p_Code
        importing p_Text = p_Text ).

  endcase.

endmethod.


method REPORT_UNSAFE_QUERY.
  data:
    statement        type sstmnt,
    token            type stokesx,
    include_Name     type syrepid,
    finding_Code     type sci_Errc,
    finding_Severity type c length 1.

  if ( abap_True eq has_External_Content ).
    finding_Code =     c_Pitfall-likely_No_Local_Content_Check.
    finding_Severity = c_Note.
  else.
    finding_Code = c_Pitfall-likely_No_Content_Check.
    finding_Severity = c_Warning.
  endif.

  read table me->ref_Scan->statements
    index query_Ndx
    into statement.
  read table me->ref_Scan->tokens
    index statement-from
    into token.

  include_Name = get_Include( p_Level = statement-level ).

  if ( include_Name is initial ).
    inform(
      p_Test  =    c_My_Name
      p_Code  =    finding_Code
      p_Kind  =    finding_Severity
      p_Param_1 =  table_Var_Name ).
  else.
    inform(
      p_Test  =        c_My_Name
      p_Code  =        finding_Code
      p_Kind  =        finding_Severity
      p_Sub_Obj_Type = c_Type_Include
      p_Sub_Obj_Name = include_Name
      p_Line =         token-row
      p_Column =       token-col
      p_Param_1 =      table_Var_Name ).
  endif.

endmethod.


method RUN .
  data:
    listener         type ref to listener,
    scanned_Source   type ref to scanned_Source,
    analyzer         type ref to for_All_Entries_Analysis.

  if ( me->ref_Scan is initial ).
    if ( me->program_Name is initial ). return. endif.
    if ( abap_False eq get( ) ).        return. endif.
  endif.

  create object listener type listener_For_Ci
    exporting
       adapter_To_Ci = me.
  create object analyzer
    exporting
